title: Welcome to the feature tour
text: Welcome to the feature tour. This microsite helps young people and adults across the East try, plan and apply for the careers that build and run five new hospitals. That means the construction careers that build each hospital, and the NHS careers that run it. One site covers both sectors, so learners see the whole picture, and employers in both share one talent pipeline.

title: Four simple menus
text: The whole site sits under four simple menus: Explore careers, Try a VWE, Plan my future, and For teachers and partners. Each one opens a panel of links, and inside a section there's a trail and section links under the header. It uses the same structure as the Powering the Great Grid site, so schools and partners already know how to find their way around.

title: Start here, in plain English
text: Near the top of the home page, six I-want-to tiles and a four-step How it works strip point each visitor to the right place. And if someone meets a term they don't know, like VWE, T Level or RAAC, there's a jargon buster. So visitors who don't know the jargon can still get where they need to go in a single click.

title: Accessibility for every learner
text: The round accessibility button changes text size, background tint and spacing, and can reduce motion. The VWE player adds read aloud, B S L and captions. This is designed for learners with S E N D, and for anyone who finds standard web pages hard to read. And the settings are remembered on their device.

title: The five Phase 1 hospitals
text: Here are the five Phase 1 hospitals: James Paget, The Queen Elizabeth, West Suffolk, Hinchingbrooke and Milton Keynes. Each card shows the N H S trust, the construction partner, the nearest college, and the VWEs set at that hospital. So learners can see that real jobs are coming to their own area, with a named employer and a local college to start with.

title: Hospitals, colleges and universities map
text: This interactive map shows the five new hospitals alongside eleven colleges and nine universities. You can toggle each layer, select a marker for details and links, and see what's nearby with rough distances. It shows learners where they can train locally for the jobs on their doorstep, and it helps partners plan their outreach.

title: Build to bedside
text: Build to bedside takes a hospital through six stages of its life: planning and design, offsite manufacture, building, commissioning, opening, and care. Each stage lists the roles involved. It shows how construction and N H S careers connect, and that the work lasts for decades, not just for the length of the build.

title: A route for every learner
text: There's a route for every learner here: school pupils, college students, university students, adults looking for work, parents and teachers. Each is a step-by-step route, with links and tick-boxes. Instead of a wall of information, every audience gets a clear next step.

title: Career finder
text: The career finder asks five quick questions, then matches the learner to job families in the N H S, in construction, or in both. It links straight through to the matching VWE and roles. It turns I don't know what I want to do into three concrete options, in about two minutes.

title: Explore 100+ careers
text: Explore more than a hundred careers. Every N H S and construction role linked to a new hospital has an illustration, a one-line description, the routes in, and a link to try it in a VWE. It's one place to compare careers across both sectors, filtered by how the learner wants to start.

title: The VWE library
text: The VWE library is the core of the programme. There are twelve virtual work experiences, each five days and twenty-five hours, aligned to national skills pathways. Six are construction V W Es that build the hospital, and six are N H S V W Es that run it. Each card shows the roles, and which levels it maps to. It's free, online work experience in every part of a new hospital.

title: Skills pathways for each VWE
text: Each VWE opens into five tabs: the five days, the skills pathway, the roles, curriculum and Gatsby links, and formats. The pathway shows every apprenticeship standard and T Level it maps to, from foundation to degree level. So every VWE leads to a real, funded route, and employers can see the standards they recruit to.

title: One-day VWE and role spotlights
text: There are shorter formats too. The one-day VWE follows a single hospital from plan to first patient, with every partner. And role spotlights let learners search ninety-six roles by key stage, and start a thirty-minute taster. They suit key stage three, job centres and youth hubs, alongside the full five-day programmes.

title: A day on site
text: This is a day on site. On Day 1 of VWE 1, the learner reads the site map, meets the site manager, takes a safety quiz, makes four site decisions, handles an ambulance curveball, writes a site diary, and earns a certificate. An A I coach gives feedback at each step, so every choice gets a response.

title: One VWE, two jobs
text: At the end of a VWE, the evidence report turns the learner's choices into a competency profile. It then matches them to one construction role and one N H S role. It replaces a C V with evidence of what the learner can actually do, which is fairer for young people with little work history.

title: Lifestyle calculator
text: The lifestyle calculator lets a learner pick an N H S job on the 2026 to 27 Agenda for Change pay scales, or a construction job. They choose where and how they'd live, and see take-home pay, monthly costs, what's left over, and how pay grows. It makes pay real for learners and their parents, and shows that an apprenticeship can fund independent living.

title: Jobs, apprenticeships and training
text: Every route here ends at a real place to apply or enrol. There are trusted links to N H S Jobs, Health Careers, Go Construct, C I T B, C S C S, Find an apprenticeship, the National Careers Service, and the college nearest each hospital.

title: My career plan
text: My career plan is a career selector and a progress tracker. Learners say what they enjoy, where they are now, and which sector interests them, and they get matching careers. Everything they shortlist, the VWEs they try, the paths they explore, and the jobs they save or apply for, is tracked across five steps, with the next step always shown. It turns browsing into a plan they can print, share with a teacher or adviser, and talk through with the coach.

title: Role tasters and job fit
text: Every role has a three-minute, game-style taster: a workplace dilemma, a put-it-in-order task, quick-fire this-or-that, and would-you-enjoy-it ratings. Learners earn X P, levels and badges, and then see a job-fit score, a strengths radar, and a ranked list of the jobs that suit them best, with fit badges on every job. It helps them decide which jobs to apply for, based on what they enjoy and how they handle real situations.

title: Career pathways
text: Career pathways show every job family as a five-step ladder, from first step to senior roles, with the level or N H S band, the pay, and the time at each stage. You can switch between construction and the N H S, see them side by side, and follow crossover routes between the two. Every role in the explorer has its own career path. It shows learners that a first job is the start of a career, and that skills carry across both sectors.

title: Inclusive by design
text: The site is inclusive by design. It has the same inclusion tools as Developing Experts: a reading ruler, read aloud, translation into community languages, B S L in the VWEs, an easy-read font, dyslexia spacing, coloured backgrounds, bigger text, high contrast and reduced motion. Choose any card to turn the tool on. That lets every learner take part, including those with S E N D, dyslexia, visual stress, Deaf learners, and families who speak another language.

title: From lesson to VWE
text: For teachers, this connects the lesson to the VWE. Every VWE is hosted on this microsite and on Developing Experts, and signposted from Developing Experts lessons. Choose a subject such as biology and a topic such as cells, and you see the hospital careers that use it, and the VWE to start. Links carry campaign tags, so visits can be counted. It connects classroom learning to real local jobs.

title: Plans and build simulation
text: Here are each hospital's published plans, with links to the trusts' own designs and films, and an illustrated simulation of the build, from today's site to handover. Every stage shows the jobs on site and the VWE to try. It shows learners the real project in their own town, and how the jobs change as a hospital goes up.

title: AI career coach
text: The A I career coach is a chat coach that knows every role, VWE, salary and sample job on the site. It asks about interests, suggests careers, and links straight to the right VWE. It never asks for personal details. It gives every learner one-to-one guidance at any time, and points them to the National Careers Service for more in-depth advice.

title: Partners and jobs
text: Partners and jobs has profiles of the five trusts and four construction partners, and their spotlight jobs. The jobs board is fed live by vacancy A P Is from each partner, covering the partners and the local supply chain, and there's help for every kind of job seeker. Each job links to the VWE that prepares you for it. So a VWE becomes a real application, and employers can recruit local people who have already tried the work.

title: Impact reports
text: Now the partner-only area. The trusts, builders and steering group open their dashboards in one click: schools and learners reached, VWE completions, placements, applications, interest before and after, who we reach, social value commitments, N E E T outcomes, reach by area, and vacancy feeds. It's evidence for Employment and Skills Plans and social value reporting, with each partner seeing its own data.

title: Government reporting
text: Government reporting gives partners ready-made returns: the P P N zero zero two social value return, C I T B Employment and Skills Plan K P Is, Gatsby Benchmark evidence for schools, N E E T outcomes for D W P and councils, and skills demand evidence for Local Skills Improvement Plans. Most figures fill in automatically. Partners confirm the rest, run the checks, and download. It saves hours every quarter, because one set of data feeds every government return.

title: Talent pipeline
text: The talent pipeline shows pipeline stages, ready learners against local hiring need by year, interest by role and area, and an opt-in talent pool with anonymous codes and mediated invitations. It helps trusts and builders plan recruitment years ahead and spot gaps early, with consent and fairness built in.

title: Watch the films
text: There are two films. The Developing Experts product film shows how virtual work experience works. The testimonial film has employers, teachers and learners on what it changed for them. Both open on YouTube. It's a quick way to explain VWE to learners, parents, teachers and partners before they try one.

title: Teachers and funding watch
text: To finish, the teachers and funding watch. It has lessons, thirty-minute C P D and Gatsby evidence for schools, a gallery of the people who build and run a hospital, and the latest apprenticeship and T Level funding changes built into the mapping. It gives schools what they need to run VWEs in class, and keeps the mapping honest as funding rules change.
